title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Fixes two bugs that let generated build files bypass the extension's exclusion patterns, so they no longer get indexed or watched by mistake.

highlights.title: Single Pattern Exclusion Fix
highlights.description: A workspace with a single entry in kotlinJump.excludePatterns had it silently ignored by the initial scan while the watcher applied it, so those files were indexed once and never refreshed. On a real project of 10064 source files, one exclusion pattern indexed all 10064 instead of 5138.

highlights.title: Root Level Build Folder Exclusion
highlights.description: The default exclusion for build and .gradle folders missed files sitting directly at the project root, the common layout for a single module Gradle project, so its build output is now skipped instead of indexed.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Restores file exclusion when kotlinJump.excludePatterns holds a single entry. That entry was silently ignored by the initial scan, while the file watcher applied it correctly, so the excluded files were indexed once and then never refreshed. On a real project of 10064 source files, setting one exclusion pattern indexed all 10064 instead of 5138.
Fixes the default build and .gradle exclusion missing files sitting directly at the project root, the usual layout of a Gradle project with a single module.

Both bugs came from the same place: the initial scan has to fold the whole list into one pattern, and it folded it wrong. Scan and watcher now agree on every list of patterns, and a test holds them to it.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No new commands or settings in this release. The fix only changes which files get indexed and watched.
